messages:
jules_cust: Hi team — our users started getting a terse 'Request too large' error from /v1/rerank around 10:12 UTC. No details in the body, just HTTP 400. It started after we shipped longer user summaries into the query field. Impact: ~18% of rerank calls fail and UX shows generic error. Can someone triage?

sara_support: thanks for reporting — can you paste the raw response + a minimal repro payload (sanitized)? also which SDK/version and model are you hitting?

jules_cust: here's sanitized curl and response we captured:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"query":"<long user summary>...","docs":[{"id":"d1","text":"..."}, {"id":"d2","text":"..."}, ...]}'

Response: HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"request too large"}

We also logged Content-Length: 48412 and the callers are sending ~120 docs per request. Model param: rerank-1 (embedding-based rerank). SDK: javascript 2.6.1.

devin_engineer: that 400 with vague body matches a generic upstream body size rejection. Are you certain the error is coming from our rerank service (not a reverse proxy)? Any x-request-id or traces?

jules_cust: we have x-request-id: r-9b12ff in logs, traced it to the rerank route. No stacktrace beyond 400.

kevin_sre: quick checks: likely hitting token/size limit in the reranker (server-side tokenization + docs array length). Two action items: (1) short-term workaround for the customer, (2) long-term: improve error message and server-side validation.

kevin_sre: for immediate workaround — reduce docs per call to <= 50, and truncate each doc to ~2000 chars (or better, run client-side token-estimate function). Also consider batching requests and re-aggregating results.

sara_support: can you provide a small repro we can use to reproduce internally? even a stripped down payload with 60 short docs vs 120 shorter ones to see threshold.

jules_cust: attaching sanitized payload now (pasted into thread). The failing payload has ~120 docs, average 1200 chars per doc, query length ~3400 chars.

devin_engineer: I'm going to reproduce locally. Two notes for product/infra: the API should return HTTP 413 Payload Too Large when input exceeds configured token limit and include a details object like {"field": "docs", "doc_index": 89, "token_count": 15432, "max_tokens": 8192}. Right now the client only sees 'request too large' which is useless. I'll open an internal change.

kevin_sre: agreed. Also add logging metric for rejected rerank requests by reason (docs_count, tokens) so we can surface if customers commonly hit this. Filing INF-2345 to track.

devin_engineer: repro steps I'm running:
1) use the customer's payload and run local rerank service with same model config
2) measure tokenization using our tokenizer script (approx char->tokens = chars/4)
3) increase docs until we hit the limit and capture error body

devin_engineer: sample quick check snippet (python):

```python
from tiktoken_like import encode
query = open('query.txt').read()
docs = [open(f'd{i}.txt').read() for i in range(120)]
tokens = len(encode(query)) + sum(len(encode(d)) for d in docs)
print('token_count', tokens)
```

sara_support: please paste the final produced error payload once you get it — customer is asking for concrete guidance while we update docs.

devin_engineer: got it. Reproduced locally — when tokens > 8192 service returns HTTP 400 with body "request too large". I'll change it to 413 + details. Patch plan: nonbreaking error schema that adds optional "details" object and a new error code "RERANK_INPUT_TOO_LARGE". Dev will include which field caused rejection, counts, and recommended truncation.

sara_support: perfect. Also we should add a KB note with: 1) how to estimate tokens, 2) code samples for client-side check, 3) batching guidance, 4) quick troubleshooting checklist.

kevin_sre: timeline — dev to land minimal change in 3 days behind feature flag, rollout to prod after canary. I will create an anomaly alert to watch for increases in 413s. Ticket INF-2345 assigned to @devin_engineer and @kevin_sre.

jules_cust: thanks — short-term can you share the client-side pre-check snippet? we'll add to our SDK.

devin_engineer: sample JS pre-check (paste):

```js
// approximate tokens ~= Math.ceil(chars / 4)
function estimateTokens(str){ return Math.ceil(str.length / 4); }
function precheck(query, docs, maxTokens=8192){
  const q = estimateTokens(query);
  const d = docs.reduce((s,x)=>s+estimateTokens(x.text),0);
  return {ok: q + d <= maxTokens, tokens: q + d};
}
```

sara_support: nice. I'll send that to @jules_cust and update the support KB. Also updating the SDK to include a precheck util.

infra_bot: note: INF-2345 created by kevin_sre at 2026-03-15T11:45:00Z — severity=P3 — summary: rerank requests return ambiguous "request too large" 400; propose 413 + details.

jules_cust: thanks all. We'll implement batching client-side till server-side change lands. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

kevin_sre: follow-up: once we deploy, we'll backfill a migration doc showing old vs new error shapes and recommended client behavior.

sara_support: assigning follow-up to docs + sdk teams. leaving thread open until prod rollout.

jules_cust: leaving a note for support ticket #SUP-9987 that we provided workaround and will re-open if issue persists.
